objective: Make the production story template directly consumable by the strict upstream-compatible story parser

acceptance.text: A filled production story template parses with the integrated strict reader, preserving all declared headers, exact acceptance text and unclaimed state.
Story header separators and Parallel-safe field match upstream format without loosening parser validation or modifying pinned upstream fixtures.
A meaningful regression exercises actual production template bytes through installed/runtime parser behavior so incompatible template/parser changes cannot pass silently.
